metrics.name: Total Contact Count
metrics.gotcha: ContactsCount is a pre-aggregated SCALAR integer at the top level — NOT an array. Do not use length(). The IT Glue API returns this as a summary field rather than populating a Contacts[] array.

metrics.name: Domain Count
metrics.gotcha: Domains[] fields include: Id, OrganizationId, OrganizationName, Name, RegistrarName, ExpiresOn, Restricted, Notes, CreatedAt, UpdatedAt.

metrics.name: Flexible Asset Type Count
metrics.gotcha: FlexibleAssetTypes[] fields include: Id, Name, Description, Icon, Enabled, CreatedAt, UpdatedAt. These are the template types (e.g. 'Firewall', 'Domain Registrar'), not individual asset instances.

metrics.name: Active Organization Count
metrics.gotcha: OrganizationStatusName is a STRING ('Active', 'Inactive', etc.). Some organizations (e.g. the MSP's own top-level org) have null OrganizationStatusName — the filter safely excludes them since null != 'Active'. No explicit null guard needed; the equality filter handles it.

metrics.name: Total Organization Count
metrics.gotcha: Organizations[] includes the MSP's own account plus all client orgs. Fields include: Id, Name, OrganizationStatusId, OrganizationStatusName, OrganizationTypeName, PsaIntegration, SyncActive, ParentId, ShortName, Alert, HasPersonalPasswords.

metrics.name: Total User Count
metrics.gotcha: Users[] fields include: Id, FirstName, LastName, Name, RoleName, RoleId, Email, InvitationSentAt, InvitationAcceptedAt, CurrentSignInAt, LastSignInAt (ISO string or null), Reputation, MyGlue, AllOrganizations.

metrics.name: Users Who Have Signed In Count
metrics.gotcha: Users[].LastSignInAt is null for invited users who have never logged in. Use null guard. Format when present: ISO timestamp string e.g. '2025-09-29T19:37:33.000Z'.
